response.original_title: The Jungle Book - A Girlfriend for Mowgli
response.overview: A newborn boy gets lost in the jungle and is adopted by a family of wolves. From this point on he is known as Mowgly. Mowgly is loved by his wolf mother and accepted as a brother by the wolf puppies. Mowgly has two exceptional teachers: Bagheera, a panther who has lived a long time among Humans, and Baloo; a very friendly bear.
